# LangSlice

> LangSlice registers histology brain sections to BrainGlobe atlases. A user's coding-agent app (Codex, Antigravity, Claude Code) creates a job folder for one brain with `langslice-job FOLDER init`, launches one registration agent with the prompt `langslice-job FOLDER launch --role register|register-scripting` writes, and checks the saved pictures. Install from PyPI into a Python 3.11 conda environment named `langslice`: `pip install "langslice[registration,mcp]"`.

Rules for an agent setting up a registration: never register sections yourself; put the user's notes in the job (`init --notes`); pass `result.prompt` of `launch` to the registration agent unchanged; run `launch` again for each launch; judge the result by its pictures, not the agent's summary.

## Docs

- [Install LangSlice (for agents)](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agents/install.html): install, verification, connecting Codex, Antigravity and Claude Code
- [Register a brain](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/register.html): what the user prepares, what to tell the agent, checking, the result files
- [Tools](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tools.html): every registration tool in one line
- [ABBA](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/abba.html): the Fiji connector
- [Troubleshooting](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/troubleshooting.html)

## Reference (in the repository)

- [The agent CLI](https://github.com/greenpolo/LangSlice/blob/main/docs/agents/cli.md): jobs, launch prompts, verbs, replies, background runs, the job's Python environment
- [The MCP server](https://github.com/greenpolo/LangSlice/blob/main/docs/agents/mcp.md): `langslice mcp`, `start_job`
- [The built-in agent](https://github.com/greenpolo/LangSlice/blob/main/docs/agents/builtin.md): `langslice linear run`, its own flags, spend, logs
- [Tools and options](https://github.com/greenpolo/LangSlice/blob/main/docs/reference/tools.md): every tool's arguments, what a job can switch off
- [Job settings](https://github.com/greenpolo/LangSlice/blob/main/docs/reference/settings.md): every `init` setting with its flag and default
- [Job folder and file formats](https://github.com/greenpolo/LangSlice/blob/main/docs/reference/file_formats.md): the job folder, coordinate conventions, maps, exports, importing a registration
- [Python library](https://github.com/greenpolo/LangSlice/blob/main/docs/developers/library.md)
- [Tool plugins](https://github.com/greenpolo/LangSlice/blob/main/docs/developers/plugins.md)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/greenpolo/LangSlice/blob/main/docs/developers/architecture.md)
- [Source and connectors](https://github.com/greenpolo/LangSlice)
